notes.title: Patch 4.1
notes.content:
This patch includes small adjustments to playable characters in survival and boss rush modes,
and new audios in a couple of story mode cutscenes.

notes.title: ¡New characters join Survival & Boss Rush!
notes.content:
3 new characters join the fighters available in Boss Rush and Survival mode!

[previewyoutube=VETRJMDrUdQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Dr. Sitho, Koatl's ally in the game, also joins the fight, using mysterious iron arms that emerge from a portal. To unlock him you must find all the treasures of the White capes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/3c8f365c1f1327cf9dafbcc64c53c33dc44fb8d1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/9969f65a214e391ad2821e2ae346b94ee71bab65.jpg[/img]

Micté, the lady of the dead, will also join Koatl with the help of her death whistle! To unlock her you must find all the masks stolen by the ghosts from the Mask Museum!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/0d0d0d7b0a0cf7b2508b42015fa79046804200f0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/d9cd6e4bc44b2f01d35dfc0ba861c538dbe3ce2c.jpg[/img]

And Finally Ixchell, the Eagle warrior will show off her skills if you manage to find all the comics lost in the tunnels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/d9d0144085e8a7fe43f974abd895a4c87ea6fb06.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/301921bf19beafae4f580655c1c9d7109f2447e7.jpg[/img]

Thank you very much for playing Koatl the defender!

notes.title: Koatl x Chahneke
notes.content:
Koatl the defender and the lost tunnels has a new collaboration with the Chahneke Footwear brand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/d54d254dc7eb4601ac9bcd46ba616606d756c8b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/9a6e712402c34a00483b30a57d57b0dc3b90c4a5.png[/img]

Along with his already spectacular catalog of shoe designs, Chahneke has created a new shoe featuring original art of Koatl the Defender! There are two different designs, Mictlan and Supremo and you can find them [url=https://chahneke.com/producto/koatl/]Here[/url]

and not only that, but in the game you can find a pair of shoes for Koatl to wear!

Just go to the Evangeline's Library and you will find them there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/47bde6003b2f33cbff5d4b43fcae9b31fdcf7849.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/47510c721a0171f64f86e85a5dac18cee2552b34.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/9d78b465792d23fc4565d8cd67cadece77880da6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/d3e48283ac425b6be290d1c681524a5f17fe9b1b.png[/img]

Thanks and keep playing!

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
This Patch adds several things:

[list]
[*] Survive and Boss Rush mode are available to anybody who has beat the game
[*] New achivements for these new modes
[*] Fixed and more clear first tutorial level
[*] New voices for some of the cutscenes
[/list]

notes.title: New Game Modes Are coming!!
notes.content:
We are really close to the first anniversary of Koatl and the lost tunnels next January, we've added many things as the year goes on, like translation, little fixes and now we're gonna add two new game modes, Boss Rush and Survivall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/d66bb404ce14c535d63a45974f90a5a98a1d7d35.jpg[/img]

Boss Rush will face you against 9 bosses in a row, picking weapons and healing items once in a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/b28050e76843fd0774466fa1e68c07764fcd485b.jpg[/img]

Survivall in the other hand will throw you in a never ending rush of enemies spawning every couple of seconds. every 50 enemies defeated they'll change a bit and become a bit more dangerous. Look out for the drops each enemy leaves behind after dying, you can find small heals, big heals, stamina refill and the powerfull Xiuhcoatl, that destroys every enemy on the stage.

How many enemies can you defeat?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/dc48c0d5cd9af2556f07fd34f7d63d39cc6d9c01.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/fed693c90c50e93e38d453822dc5e17994f3ce37.jpg[/img]

Boss Rush and Survivall will be available once you beat the game for the first time, and also, Koatl won't be the only character available, if you collect all of Evangeline Scrolls on your adventure you can use her in both moves too!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544487/76bf2caf3d3d8ddf198328042f5067f13d3a043e.jpg[/img]

and more characters will be coming soon... :)

We will be releasing these modes very soon, thank you very much for playing Koatl the Defender!

notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.content:
With this update we patch some errors that prevented some trophies from being obtained.

[list]
[*]The last 4 art books can be purchased at the mask museum
[*]A comic was unobtainable in the base game, we have added it to one of the tunnels
[*]An Letter from Evangeline could be lost if you didn't get it from its original location, since after a point in the game you can never go back there.
[*] Some of Dr Sitho's dialogues did not appear correctly with the translation
[/list]

notes.title: Koatl and the Lost Tunnels Update 2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We bring you a small update of Koatl and the lost tunnels, in this update you will find the following:

[list]
[*]translation of Dr. Sitho's shop regarding buy and sell options
[*]Artbook button translation settings
[*]Translation of the pause menu in Spanish and English
[*]The Second Prologue of the Game when Julian becomes Koatl now has voices!
[/list]

Thank you very much for continuing to support the game, we will continue to update it!

notes.title: English translation v1.0 is Ready!
notes.content:
The first English translated version of Koatl the Defender and the Lost Tunnels is here!

There are some parts that may require a little more work, but a first version to enjoy the game in English is ready.

To change the language, just go to the settings screen in the main menu and change the language there.
